translation: After Nana Parekh, since no one remained behind at Darapara, the gadi (the guru's seat of succession) was brought from Darapura to Vadodara; Bhagwan Swami brought it from Darapara to Hathipol. From Hathipol, Bhagnadas Swami brought it, in Samvat 1954, to Vayadapol, at the fair (mela) of Ranchhod Haribhai. When the site of Gordhan Pitambar became available for installing the gadi, Bhagat Ishwarbhai Zaverbhai had a new building constructed on the Gordhan Pitambar site and installed the gadi there on Shravan Vad-8 of Samvat 1982; it continues there to this day. Thus this Vadodara is a sacred site.
